text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Magnificent! Utterly magnificent! A round 
of applause for the champion of this 
year's Arima Kinen!!
(Wooooaaah--------!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Mayano Top Gun is surprisingly 
amazing. For a second there, I thought she 
might actually beat Brian.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if that's what you think, your eyes 
still have a long way to go. This is the 
difference in our true ability.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well, but she definitely had the strength. 
In the Arima Kinen a year from now... she 
might just have a shot.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *wheeze*...! *cough*... 
*pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Mayano, are you alright? You're 
looking really worn out...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. Are you her trainer? Looks 
like this girl pushed herself to her 
absolute limit. You'd better let her rest 
right away...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. More importantly, Maya...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Because it started getting fun!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Now then, moving on to the next question. 
If you have a question, please raise your 
hand—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Yeeees, coming--!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Now then, the person over there is... 
Mayano Top Gun-san!?
(Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Brian-san! Which race are you 
running in next!?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with Brian-san one more 
time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Until the very end, I didn't know what 
would happen or what I should do, and my 
heart was pounding...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I just got super excited, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Hmph. Moderator, the next question...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait up! No fair! Don't run away!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Oho?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"What did you just say? That I'm running 
away from you?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you did! 'Cause you totally tried to 
run away from Maya's challenge!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even though you're so strong, even though 
you sparkle like that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Are you secretly thinking that you might 
lose if you race against Maya next time?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... Miss Mayano Top Gun? You just 
lost your race, so—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But I'm gonna win next time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya is finally about to sparkle. So I 
won't settle for just this!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
N-No... another match is a bit much. The 
difference in skill is clearly—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...The Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've answered your question. Host, bring 
on the next person.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... Yes! Now then, next person—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Mayano can do some pretty interesting 
stuff too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Jumping in so recklessly, huh. Is it 
because you're a fearless child, or—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You sure think very highly of Mayano 
too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nice. I'll be sure to remember the two of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! Maya wants to run in the 
Hanshin Daishoten next!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how did you know? Telepathy!? Or the 
red string of fate!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. To be able to figure even that out, 
you really are Maya's Trainer-chan, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm totally gonna beat 
Brian-san in the Hanshin Daishoten☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I'm charging into turbulence, I'll face 
it head-on, fair and square! Because 
that's Maya's flight path!
